attr.title: RG808
attr.desc: A Roland TR-808 style drum machine: 1-16-step sequencer with 11 classic voices (BD, SD, toms, hats, clave, clap, cowbell, cymbal), per-step accents, swing, ratchet rolls/flams, per-voice sample selection (up to 16 kit variants), sample-accurate timing, a 200-slot pattern library, 512-bar song chains with WAV export, and per-pattern master effects (bitcrusher/overdrive/compression, flanger/phaser, tempo-synced delay, reverb). Built with C and SDL2 for 640x480 handhelds.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
